planus.name: Planus
planus.audience: Couples and families who share the bills
planus.description: Planus is a financial platform for couples and families who share the bills. Instead of recording what has already been spent, it projects the months ahead: recurring bills and expected expenses become a monthly forecast, the budget is set together by category, and comparing forecast against budget shows in advance whether the month closes in the black or in the red — enough to decide on a trip or a deposit knowing the impact before committing to it.

toNotch.name: to-notch
toNotch.audience: MacBook users who want their tasks always in sight
toNotch.description: to-notch is an open source macOS app that turns the MacBook's notch into a to-do list. Hover to see the next pending task; click to open the full list, with editing, descriptions, drag-to-reorder and a progress bar right below the notch. It runs without a Dock icon, launches at login and, on screens without a notch, uses a strip in the center of the menu bar.
